checks.pillar: Debt principal, puts, maturities and contingent conversions
checks.observation: June 30 table: $6.713659bn convertible principal; earliest stated holder put September 15, 2027 on $1.01bn 2028 notes, ahead of September 15, 2028 maturity. Additional puts in 2028/2029 and fundamental-change cash rights.
checks.implication: Any intervening retirement/conversion/new issue and future holder elections; current exact cash need is not established from the old table alone.
checks.nextProof: New debt filing, conversion trigger, redemption/put notice, or Q3 balance-sheet update.

checks.pillar: Each preferred series rights and EUR exposure
checks.observation: STRF/STRC/STRK are cumulative; STRD is noncumulative; STRK can convert and some distributions may involve common shares. STRE is euro denominated. Cadence proposal covers only U.S.-listed four series, with annual rates unchanged.
checks.implication: Future rates, dynamic liquidation preferences, arrears, conversion choices, FX and any amendment not yet effective.
checks.nextProof: New certificate, declaration, unpaid dividend, conversion or EUR/USD change relevant to obligation calculations.
checks.cadence: Each declaration, daily for due declared payments

checks.pillar: USD Reserve versus USD Cash and pending-settlement status
checks.observation: October 18: reserve $4.83bn; USD Cash $447.3m. Reserve supports dividends/interest; buybacks use non-reserve funding under policy.
checks.implication: Current intraday balance, settlement, interest income and later use; management-designated is not automatically creditor escrow.
checks.nextProof: Any unexplained pool transfer, policy revision, unexpected cash payment or source-of-funds mismatch.

checks.pillar: BTC sales versus claim-retirement benefit
checks.observation: BTC sold in late July/early August for dividends and buybacks; repurchases and common issuance continue.
checks.implication: Future BTC sold, tax realization, execution prices, whether each net transaction improves diluted common residual value.
checks.nextProof: New monetization or repurchase disclosure; reconcile BTC, cash, common and preferred claims together.

checks.pillar: Current voting influence and future cadence vote
checks.observation: Definitive special-meeting proxy reports Saylor voting power 32.9% at its dated snapshot; proposal needs shareholder approval and filed effective certificates.
checks.implication: Vote outcome, latest group/control holdings and whether/when certificates become effective.
checks.nextProof: October 28 voting result and later charter filing; material insider disclosures.

checks.pillar: Custodian legal title, concentration and failure risk
checks.observation: Annual filing names Anchorage, Coinbase and Fidelity with dated allocations; Q2 warns custody assets might enter insolvency estate despite safeguards.
checks.implication: Current allocation, insurance recoverability, private terms, live keys, subcustody and all counterparty exposures.
checks.nextProof: Custodian incident, withdrawal restriction, adverse regulatory notice or change in collateral/holding policy.

checks.pillar: Brazil CADE proceeding and unasserted contingent liabilities
checks.observation: June 30 Q2 note says SG/CADE recommended immunity/no fines in February; Tribunal decision pending; prior BRL payments disclosed. Company cannot estimate a further loss range.
checks.implication: Later Tribunal disposition, unasserted matters, legal costs and insurance; no post-August docket investigation was completed here.
checks.nextProof: Next legal note or original authority/issuer outcome disclosure.

checks.pillar: Cash taxes versus unrealized BTC marks and tax allowances
checks.observation: Q2 records domestic deferred tax assets offset in full by valuation allowance; realized BTC capital-loss and unrealized marks have different tax implications.
checks.implication: Subsequent gains, allowance releases, cash taxes, rule changes and any CAMT relief changes.
checks.nextProof: Q3 tax note, original tax guidance or material realization.

checks.pillar: Q3 earnings, amendments and payment-path validation
checks.observation: Vote October 28; results October 29; conditional STRC daily record November 1/payment November 2; other U.S. preferred daily start expected January 2027 if approved.
checks.implication: Approval, effective filing, actual payments and any postponement.
checks.nextProof: Check each official outcome; no forecast direction/probability assigned.

checks.pillar: Common issuance, compensation and matched dilution
checks.observation: October 12-18 report records 140,872 MSTR common shares sold for $22m net. Issuer-defined assumed diluted shares include contingent conversions and employee equity; this differs from GAAP diluted loss EPS.
checks.implication: Future issuance, grants, performance vesting, conditional conversions and whether the denominator matches claims removed in the valuation numerator.
checks.nextProof: New ATM, award, conversion, repurchase or a numerator/denominator mismatch.

checks.pillar: Software cash generation versus treasury cash obligations
checks.observation: Q2 includes an operating software business, BTC valuation changes, preferred distributions and cash-tax accounting. Software revenue and gross profit are not equivalent to free cash available for preferreds and debt.
checks.implication: Post-June operating cash flow, cloud-transition cash costs, all preferred payment funding and current debt interest requirements.
checks.nextProof: Q3 cash-flow statement; unexpected reserve depletion; inability to fund a declared payment or debt requirement.

checks.pillar: Management succession, incentives and confidence
checks.observation: Special-meeting materials identify Michael Saylor as executive chairman and Phong Le as president/CEO; management advocates the proposed daily cadence.
checks.implication: Succession readiness, private board deliberations, investor confidence and future compensation/related-party decisions.
checks.nextProof: Leadership departure, major related-party transaction, unusual award or material change in capital allocation.

checks.pillar: Quarterly assurance and current financial-statement completeness
checks.observation: Latest full periodic statements reviewed are June 30 unaudited statements filed August 3; weekly treasury disclosures are not a continuous financial audit.
checks.implication: Unpublished audit findings, post-quarter adjustments, full current liabilities and any future restatement or control change.
checks.nextProof: Q3 release/10-Q, auditor disagreement, late filing, restatement or disclosed material weakness.
checks.cadence: Each periodic report and adverse disclosure

checks.pillar: Shared BTC concentration and network tail risk
checks.observation: Both issuer strategies expose corporate assets and security values to BTC market, transfer and network conditions. BTC itself has no native cash dividend.
checks.implication: Future BTC prices, protocol/cryptographic failures, exchange liquidity, miner behavior and hidden market leverage.
checks.nextProof: Material network/service incident, inaccessible assets or a stress scenario that changes cash/claim coverage.

checks.pillar: Market premium versus common residual backing
checks.observation: A common share is a residual corporate claim after senior obligations and costs; it has no simple holder right to redeem at gross BTC NAV. A premium can compress while BTC appreciates.
checks.implication: A durable fair premium, future financing demand and market liquidity; no required market multiple or price floor is observable.
checks.nextProof: Significant change in issuance economics, residual NAV per matched diluted share or capital-market access.

checks.pillar: Free float, short interest and live borrow
checks.observation: Official short interest is a delayed dated position snapshot; daily short-sale volume is a trading flow and cannot substitute. Share issuance/registration changes tradable supply.
checks.implication: Verified current borrow fee/availability, borrower concentration and a consistent cutoff free float/short-interest denominator for each issuer.
checks.nextProof: New official snapshot, registration/lockup change, trading halt, liquidity deterioration or documented lending recall.
checks.cadence: Each official publication and material issuance

checks.pillar: Corporate discretion, digital-asset law and capital access
checks.observation: Corporate treasury securities differ from regulated BTC funds. Boards and governing documents determine financing, custody policy, distributions and permitted transactions, subject to applicable law.
checks.implication: Future regulation, sanctions exposure, classification challenges, tax law and whether legal restrictions prevent payments or transactions.
checks.nextProof: Binding new rule, regulator action, material strategy change or distribution restriction.
checks.cadence: Quarterly and immediately on material action

checks.pillar: MSCI policy versus final issuer-specific outcome
checks.observation: October 15 rule decision schedules a November review. Preliminary issuer lists are not final actions; index inclusion and corporate listing are distinct questions.
checks.implication: Final November 11 outcomes, exact passive holdings, anticipated active trading and flow/price effects.
checks.nextProof: Final review list, correction and November 30 implementation notices.
checks.cadence: November 11 and November 30; interim official updates

checks.pillar: Balance dates, settlement and price synchronization
checks.observation: Issuer financial statements and treasury tables are dated observations. A quote can update without corporate BTC, liabilities or common-share inputs updating at the same time.
checks.implication: Intra-period asset/cash movements, unsettled proceeds and complete current liabilities before disclosure.
checks.nextProof: Mismatched timestamps, unexplained reconciliation or a newly published original filing.

checks.pillar: Scope of undiscovered information
checks.observation: A review can identify disclosed events and a wide risk taxonomy; it cannot prove the absence of unknown, private, delayed or undiscovered material information.
checks.implication: Unknown future news, undisclosed liabilities, private contracts, hidden counterparty failures and reporting delays.
checks.nextProof: New original information or unexplained discrepancy; preserve unresolved status rather than invent a complete explanation.
